Yaya Han on Instagram: "Today @mcdonalds launched their collab with @kpopdemonhuntersnetflix and they sent me the most adorable care package!!

Sorry this unboxing is so unhinged lmao, and that's after cutting down the video a lot for time 🤪

And spoiler alert - @mcdonalds included a giftcard which led me to impromptu visit the nearest location to get the KPDH meals... dressed as Rumi! 🫣

This was NOT planned, and in fact... we got so much footage that I have to make a Part 2 video 🤦‍♀️!

So yeah, stay tuned, more Huntrix x McDonald's shenanigans coming soon! 

Did you get a meal box today? What did you think of the Demon sauce? 👀

#mcdonaldskpopdemonhunters
#mcdonalds
#kpopdemonhunters"

Did you get a meal box today? What did you think of the Demon sauce? 👀#mcdonaldskpopdemonhunters#mcdonalds#kpopdemonhuntersI got both meals finally yesterday and loved both. They forgot my hunter sauce though, so guess I gotta try again today 😂Ive has the huntrix mealwith the hunter sauce and the derpy mcflurry. I enjoyed themOmg how how how can I get one of these?Ohhhh I love the cards!!!I want ittttt. This is sick. Also respect on you for leaving the post. I just wish the meal had more food than just the nuggiesThat's pretty sweet. Hold on to those cards, I hear they're going to be rare. As opposed to just picking up a box and filling the rest of the pages.Ahhhh! That care package is soooo cool!! I also went to McDonalds dressed as Rumi! It was so much fun, especially interacting with the kiddos!!Who made your wig it’s stunning xxThis is so cute! I didn't know about any of that boycott stuff either. People need to stop being keyboard commandos.The ramyeon seasoning is really tastyThe crazy thing is, there’s no actual boycott of McDonald’s regarding Gaza. All of this “drama” is performative and was caused because a Franchisee of a McDonald’s in Israel said he would give free meals to IDF members. McDonald’s the corporation has no say in any of that. But, trolls are gonna troll, and that’s if it isn’t bot accounts that are just trying to stir up trouble.
